title: A shared Swift package for the iOS apps, only if the copies start to hurt
why: The iOS kit consultation, Oct 27: keychain wrappers (about 80 to 170 lines) sit in home-app, degen and mailaudit; small WebSocket clients in home-app and mailaudit.
note: Deferred (triage, Oct 27): not now. The overlap is small, and mailaudit is public, so a private package would break its CI. Revisit when a fourth app needs the keychain wrapper, or a bug fixed in one copy turns up in another. Port: no. Minor: home-app CI runs on macos-latest; the others pin macos-26. Report: https://claude.ai/artifact/36CtFQ6CaTszMaxxZvuCXq.
